description: 引离白后——解法2：Qxe1引后离d1，后Qh5绝杀
explanation_en: If White's queen captures the rook instead, Black uses Qh5# to mate along the h-file. The queen cannot leave its defensive post without allowing mate.

intro.popup: 💡 解法2：白后吃车（不是白车），黑后Qh5绝杀！
intro.popup_en: 💡 Variation 2: If White's queen captures the rook instead of the rook, Black has Qh5#.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：若白后来吃车（Qxe1），d1空虚无关，但黑后Qh5直接绝杀h2白王——后在h5通过h线控制王。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: After Qxe1, Black plays Qh5# along the h-file. The queen sacrifice forces the defender to leave its post, allowing mate against the king on h2.

moves.popup_en: Black again starts with Re1! and waits to see how White responds.

moves.popup: 白后Qxe1！白后来吃（而非白车），d1暂时空虚。
moves.popup_en: White's queen captures on e1 instead of the rook, leaving d1 temporarily empty.

moves.popup: 黑后Qh5# 绝杀！白王h2在h线上被后将死——h列全控制。
moves.popup_en: Qh5# is checkmate! The queen controls the h-file and mates the white king on h2.
